Skins.Farm is a captivating mobile application for iOS users, offering free skins and savings on purchases by completing a variety of tasks and playing entertaining mini-games.

How can you get free gold?
We offer the following mini-games and tasks that you can complete to earn free gold:
• Daily Bonus - don't forget to collect daily gifts by visiting our app every day!
• "Quiz" Mini-Game - a fun test of your knowledge where you earn rewards for correct answers.
• "Reaction Training" Mini-Game - an exciting challenge that tests your gaming precision and reaction (also known as "aim training").
• Partner Tasks - a variety of tasks provided by our partners.
In Skins.Farm, the primary way to earn free gold is through partner tasks, known as "offers." The list of available tasks is constantly updated, and users are rewarded for their completion within 15 minutes, though in rare cases it may take up to 24 hours.

The referral program in Skins.Farm allows you to earn additional gold by inviting friends to the app. For each friend who starts playing the mini-games, you earn free gold.

Free Skins and Their Withdrawal
In our mobile app, you have access to over 600 items from the game, ranging from the most affordable to the rarest and most expensive skins, and we always keep up with new updates.

Withdrawing Skins
Accumulated enough gold in your Skins.Farm balance? It's time to withdraw gold!
To start the withdrawal, select the appropriate item from our store and press to withdraw it.
Follow the instructions for withdrawing the item in the mobile app.

How does the withdrawal to the game work?
Unfortunately, exchanges (trades) are not yet implemented in the game, and withdrawal is carried out through the in-game market.

For this, you need to list a cheap item on the Market at a price corresponding to its value in our mobile app.

Listed the item? You just need to wait a bit for the moderators to purchase your item at a favorable price, which typically takes from 15 to 30 minutes, and in rare cases up to 24 hours.

Skins.Farm provides users with a convenient and safe way to withdraw skins, making the game even more exciting and interesting.
